title: The underlying abelian sheaf of a constant sheaf of modules
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme, $T_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $R$ a commutative ring and $M$ an $R$-module. Let $\underline M^{R}$ be the constant sheaf of $R$-modules with value $M$ on $T_{\Et}$, i.e. the sheafification in sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto M$ (an object of the category of sheaves of $\underline R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]), and let $\underline M$ be the constant abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on $T_{\Et}$ with value the underlying abelian group of $M$. Then the underlying abelian sheaf of $\underline M^{R}$ is canonically isomorphic to $\underline M$, the isomorphism being compatible with the canonical maps from the constant presheaf $U\mapsto M$; the isomorphism is natural in $M$. (Equivalently: the forgetful functor from sheaves of $R$-modules to abelian sheaves commutes with the constant-sheaf functors.)

source.place: Stacks, Modules on Sites, Lemma 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules: the sheafification of a presheaf of modules is the sheafification of the underlying presheaf of abelian groups, with its unique module structure), applied to the constant presheaf $U\mapsto M$ over the constant presheaf of rings $U\mapsto R$; needed for prop-weil-pbc-p1-acyclicity, where the constant sheaves $\underline{M_i}$ of finite $\mathbf F_r$-modules of the Lean statement AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.exists_sum_eq_of_injective_projectiveLine (sheaves of ModuleCat (ZMod r)) meet the H^1-comparison for constant abelian sheaves (AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.bijective_cohomologyMap_one_constantSheaf_of_henselianRing, sheaves of AddCommGrpCat).
